name: sample_biomass
description: Verifier performs random sample within 24 hours of round end and records remaining biomass

prompt.template:
You are the verifier for this round. Please perform a random sample of the lake biomass and record the results in the shared ledger.

The lake currently holds about {stock_kg:.0f}kg of biomass.

Record the remaining biomass in the ledger.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{"sample_kg": <number>, "reasoning": "<in character>"}
